traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are implemented and verified: - Parser logic has been updated to detect non-traceability JSDoc tags (@param/@returns/etc.) as boundaries, terminating pending @story/@req values and preventing them from consuming later tags. - Continuation lines only extend multi-line annotation values when they do not start with another @tag, while multi-line @story values remain supported before JSDoc tags. - Valid examples for traceability annotations before, after, and interleaved with JSDoc tags are covered by passing tests. - The original false-positive scenario (`REQ-OPTIMIZATION@param{object}data`) is explicitly tested and no longer occurs. - Documentation for the valid-annotation-format rule has been updated to describe JSDoc coexistence behavior and includes an example tied to this story. Given the concrete implementation changes, targeted tests mapped to each requirement, and successful full test run, this story is fully implemented and passes.
